title: Summarize large tables with KPI band above collapsed detail
problemCues: More than ten total rows; users need overview before scanning detail rows
preconditions: Full dataset count known before search/pagination; shared DataGrid features remain
decision: Show useful KPI boxes or an infographic above an immediately adjacent, initially collapsed detail table. Count the full dataset, not the visible page. KPI actions open and filter related details; unknown metrics stay unknown.
tradeoffs: Adds vertical space and a collapse control; worth it when overview decisions dominate raw row scanning
exceptions: Fewer than or equal to ten total rows; or an explicit product owner instruction to keep a flat table
example: Nucleus weekly board / report pages with summary census
validatedBy: Browser measure plus usability objects for summary band and grid; compare against product sibling
